plain_statement: It is false that: A circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates on ten wires: eight inputs, a wire b in fifth place, and the negation of b last. If at least two gates read b or its negation, and with b false the circuit is false somewhere, then the function it computes with b false has a circuit on the eight inputs at least two gates smaller.
